summary: Public video/category API checks passed with 120 videos and 9 categories, but OpenNext Cloudflare build failed and the deployed UI/routes are not functional.

critical.issue: Intermittently returns HTTP 500 HTML from the public Cloudflare endpoint (also reproduced after successful earlier requests).

Admin credentials request returns HTTP 500 from the public endpoint in direct curl; a prior request returned a bare user object without token/user wrapper, so the expected authenticated response contract is not stable.

ui_bugs.issue: Page renders essentially unstyled/default browser controls and no watch links/cards were present in the DOM despite API containing 120 videos.
TV route loads but displays 'Menampilkan 0 Episode' and no episodes despite videos being available.
The requested watch route produced an empty document/body during browser navigation.

integration_issues.issue: API returns 120 videos, but client-rendered homepage has zero watch links and TV has zero episodes.

issues: CSS appears missing or fails to load; controls and typography render as browser defaults, with severe layout degradation.

action_items: Fix @libsql/isomorphic-ws resolution so yarn build:worker completes and produces a deployable worker.
Investigate public /api/settings and /api/auth/login 500s and make login response consistently return the frontend's expected session/token shape.
Fix client data-loading/rendering so homepage cards and TV episodes consume the successful /api/videos payload.
Fix missing CSS/static asset delivery and verify watch route server/client rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: wrangler.json still declares a placeholder D1 database ID even though Turso is the primary engine; deployment configuration should not retain an invalid binding unless intentionally required.
lib/db.js uses dynamic require('@libsql/client'), which causes critical dependency warnings and contributes to Cloudflare bundling risk.
The build emits a duplicate duration object key warning in admin code; clean this before production deployment.
seed_data_creation: None; verified existing API data only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API videos/categories passed (120/9). Re-run settings/login from the public URL, then verify worker build, CSS assets, homepage cards, watch route, and TV episode count on desktop/mobile.
rca of the issue: OpenNext build fails because @libsql/hrana-client resolves @libsql/isomorphic-ws to missing web.cjs. Separately, browser HTML loads but styling and data-driven card rendering are absent; TV receives/uses an empty episode set while the API has 120 videos. Public settings/login also show 500 responses, indicating route/runtime instability rather than missing seed data.
